name: Workspace Names
author: Fred Nix & Larry
description: Give Hyprland workspaces a title without touching the numbers in the bar. A small pill slides in under the workspace numbers whenever you switch ("3  Code") and slides away again after a moment. Rename with SUPER+SHIFT+R (workspace-name) — names live in ~/.config/omarchy/workspace-names.json.

barWidget.description: The stock workspace numbers, plus hover a number to see its name and click the chip (or right-click the number) to rename it inline. Replaces omarchy.workspaces in the bar layout.
